senses.gloss: ) m.; pl. מֵעַיִם, מֵעַיִים, מֵעַיִין, מֵי׳(b. h.; [curve; cmp. חָלָל,] inside, bowels, belly.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kinnim 3:6">Kinn. III, 6</cite> <he>מֵעָיו לנבלים בני מֵעָיו לכנורות</he> its large intestines are used for harp-strings &c., v. <cite ref="K00846"><he>כִּנּוֹר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 22b:8">Nidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מכה יש לה בתוך מֵעֶיהָ</he> has an internal wound (abscess); (Tosef. ib. IV, 3 <he>מבפנים</he>).
Y. Naz. VII, 56ᶜ bot. תחת מֵעֵי הגמל under the belly of the camel; תחת מעי השקוף under the arch of the gate.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:2">Snh. VIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:6">52ᵃ</cite>) <he>יורדת לתוך מעיו וחומרת בני מעיו</he> runs into his inside and scalds his bowels.
<cite ref="Chullin 56b:4">Ḥull. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>באלו בני מ׳ אמרו וכ׳</he> by the intestines of birds (Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">ib. III, 3</cite>) are meant the stomach, the heart &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:3">Eduy. III, 3</cite> <he>מעי אבטיח</he> the seeds and the juice of the melon (v. <cite ref="M02070">preced.</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2:4">Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ</cite> <he>מה בין מֵיעֵי מלפפון למ׳ אבטיח</he> what is the difference between the core of the melopepon and that of the melon?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:32">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="M01962"><he>מִסְמֵס</he> I</cite>.—
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 2 מעיין שלה the stuffings of the sofa.
